svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Two cases of content moderation: YouTube in 2011 and Facebook in 2019
svg.desc: Two cards. Syria, 2011, with the YouTube logo: a video shows a 13-year-old boy killed in Syria, posted to expose the regime's violence, and YouTube removes it under its rule against showing dead bodies, then restores it within days. New Zealand, 2019, with the Facebook logo: a gunman kills 51 people at two mosques and streams it live, and Facebook removes 1.5 million copies in a day and cannot stop the rest.
svg.text: A video shows a 13-year-old boy killed in Syria,
